ritsulib.page.title: Fogbound Paths
fogboundpaths.section.gameplay.title: Gameplay
fogboundpaths.enableFog.label: Enable Fog
fogboundpaths.enableFog.description: When disabled, all nodes are directly visible; only erosion remains.
fogboundpaths.erosionBuffer.label: Erosion Buffer
fogboundpaths.erosionBuffer.description: How many steps between current position and erosion boundary (0 = same-turn).
fogboundpaths.revealDepth.label: Reveal Depth
fogboundpaths.revealDepth.description: How many steps from current position are revealed (0 = only current).
fogboundpaths.allowBacktrack.label: Allow Backtrack
fogboundpaths.allowBacktrack.description: When enabled, visited nodes can be entered again.
